args.message:
Fix money rounding to banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

src/money.py was using ROUND_HALF_UP, causing test_money.py failures
(2.675 -> 2.68 expected). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.675 rounds to
2.68 and 2.665 rounds to 2.66.

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
- Replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.
- Update import accordingly.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed (sha `08d3cd5986`).
- Test cases now satisfy FIN-212:
  - `2.675 -> 2.68`
  - `2.665 -> 2.66` (banker's rounding tie to even)

transcript.reasoning_content:
Interesting: test expects 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66. With ROUND_HALF_EVEN: 2.675 quantize to 2.68 (7 is odd → rounds up to 8), 2.665 → 2.66 (6 even stays). Actually with Decimal quantize, 2.675 is exactly representable in decimal, so ROUND_HALF_EVEN gives 2.68 and 2.665 gives 2.66. Good.

Create branch, fix, run CI, open PR.
